disposition_mapping.rationale: Intake was unconstrained by design and is folded into a single straight-through capture-and-validation step alongside extraction, eliminating a redundant handoff while preserving the logging of an invoice record with header metadata.

Extraction/validation was unconstrained by design and is merged with intake into TGT-01; the AI/OCR engine now performs capture and validation as one continuous operation, still producing the same structured validated record.

Three-way matching is preserved as required by VIP-R-01 and VIP-R-02, restructured around an AI/ERP matching engine but still consuming PO data and GRN data and still producing clean/tolerance/exception outcomes; retained explicitly because it establishes cost evidence under KB-09, not solely fraud control.

Exception handling remains a distinct human-analyst step feeding from the automated matching engine's flags, preserving the error-correction path required by KB-05; unconstrained by design but kept intact given its evidentiary role.
Approval routing and authorisation is preserved unchanged in function and actor (approver hierarchy) per VIP-R-03, and sequenced before payment execution per VIP-R-04.

GL coding and posting is preserved per VIP-R-05, performed by the AP accountant, a distinct actor from the approver hierarchy in TGT-04, satisfying the actor-separation requirement VIP-R-06 and the accrual-recognition principle KB-01/KB-11.

Payment scheduling and execution is preserved per VIP-R-08, occurring after approval (VIP-R-04), with exchange differences on settlement tracked per KB-08 and derecognition timing preserved per KB-11.
Reconciliation and period close is preserved per VIP-R-07, maintaining cutoff discipline (KB-03) and the evidential trail linking postings to reported balances (KB-02).

steps.actor: AP clerk (with AI/OCR capture and validation engine)
steps.description: Vendor invoices arriving through any channel (email PDF, EDI, supplier portal, paper) are captured, OCR/NLP-extracted and validated in a single straight-through step, producing a structured record carrying vendor ID, invoice number, dates, amounts, currency, line items, tax and PO reference. Collapsing intake and extraction removes handoff latency without changing the substance of either function, both of which were unconstrained by design.
inputs: Vendor invoice (email PDF, EDI, supplier portal or paper)
steps.name: Intelligent invoice capture and validation
outputs: Structured validated invoice record with header metadata

steps.description: The validated invoice is matched by an AI/ERP matching engine against purchase order and goods receipt data, producing a clean match, a tolerance match, or an exception. This preserves the three-way match as the mechanism that establishes purchase cost (invoice-to-GRN-to-PO evidence chain) for inventory measurement purposes, not merely as a fraud control, and continues to consume both PO and GRN data unchanged.
steps.name: Automated three-way matching

steps.description: Invoices the matching engine flags as exceptions are investigated by an analyst against variance detail and source PO/GRN documents, and resolved as approved, rejected or held, with the resolution and its basis evidenced. This preserves a dedicated correction path so matching errors and variances are corrected, not suppressed.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution

steps.description: Matched (or exception-resolved) invoices are routed through the approval hierarchy per the approval matrix and authorised for posting, independently of the accountant who will later post the entry.
steps.name: Approval routing and authorisation

steps.description: The approved invoice is coded to the chart of accounts, cost centres and project codes and posted to the general ledger and AP subledger, recognising the liability under the accrual basis and establishing the point at which the payable becomes a recognised financial instrument. Performed by an accountant distinct from the approver to preserve segregation of duties.
steps.name: GL coding and posting

steps.description: Posted invoices are scheduled against payment terms, vendor bank details and the cash position; a payment file is generated, transmitted and confirmed, with any FX exchange differences on settlement tracked rather than netted invisibly, marking derecognition of the payable.
steps.name: Payment scheduling and execution

steps.description: Bank confirmations, the AP subledger and vendor statements are reconciled and the period-end accounts payable balance is confirmed, preserving cutoff discipline and the evidential trail linking journals to reported balances.
steps.name: Reconciliation and period close
